Sean — thanks for flagging. Short guidance from finance:

1) Preferred flow: EUR to our EU account (IBAN/SEPA) — minimizes FX and intermediary fees. If BetaHealth can pay EUR, ask them to use their EUR ledger to remit to the IBAN on the invoice.

2) If customer insists on USD payout:
- We can accept USD but request that they send the payment with the following condition: "OUR" ordering instruction so BetaHealth covers all intermediary/correspondent charges. If they send as "SHA" (shared), we will receive less than invoiced and will need to deduct the net shortfall from the invoice (we cannot absorb variable correspondent fees).
- Please include the intermediary bank details we provide; these routes can include an extra conversion step (EUR->USD) on the SWIFT corridor which may change realized FX. We should not reissue the invoice in USD; keep invoice as EUR and record the USD receipt as settlement of the EUR invoice at realized FX.

3) VAT: For B2B services between BetaHealth (DE) and Redwood (US-headquartered, EU operations), the invoice shows reverse-charge (customer VAT liability) where applicable — payment currency does not change VAT treatment. Confirm we have BetaHealth's VAT/Tax ID on file. If not, collect it before final settlement.

Proposed wording to send to BetaHealth (suggest you send this to keep a single thread):
"Thanks Eva — we prefer EUR settlement to our EU account to avoid double FX and intermediary fees. If you must pay in USD, please instruct your bank to send the funds with an OUR instruction so BetaHealth covers all intermediary and correspondent bank charges. If the payment arrives net (SHA), Redwood will deduct any shortfall from the invoice amount and reissue a remittance confirmation. Also please confirm BetaHealth's VAT ID for reverse-charge. Attached are our alternate USD wiring details for your treasury team."

Attaching corr bank details for USD route. Rafael, please confirm the exact intermediary values we should include and whether to add a USD beneficiary account note.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
